source.subject: s1304
source.access: HTTP range extraction of 13 mask members from the Zenodo zip; no CT image volume downloaded, nothing derived from greyscale
source.orientation_check: RAS +y = anterior (trachea centroid 13.9 mm anterior of oesophagus centroid)
source.consequence: every soft tissue on this page is CONSTRUCTED. Only the oral bony frame, the alveolar arches measured on it, the condylar axis, C1-C3 and the swallow/venous chain anchors are contour-anchored.

bigonial_breadth_mm: gonion-gonion breadth, adult; Farkas LG, Anthropometry of the Head and Face, 2nd ed. 1994 (male mean 97.1 +/- 5.8 mm, female 91.0 +/- 5.9 mm)
condylion_menton_mm: condylion-menton straight-line distance (mandibular length), adult; Farkas 1994 / craniometric series
maxilloalveolar_breadth_mm: maxillo-alveolar (EXTERNAL alveolar, ekm-ekm) breadth, adult craniometry. This is a BONE measure and is deliberately NOT the intermolar crown width (40-56 mm), which is a tooth-to-tooth measure and is used in this build only to size the teeth.
mandibuloalveolar_breadth_mm: mandibular external alveolar breadth at the molars, adult craniometry
alveolar_breadth_canine_mm: external alveolar breadth at the canine level, adult craniometry
palatal_depth_mm: hard-palate vault depth at the first molars, adult
oral_mucosa_area_cm2: total oral mucosal surface area; Collins LMC & Dawes C, J Dent Res 1987;66:1300-2
parotid_volume_mL: adult parotid gland volume, MRI/CT volumetry
circumvallate_papillae: circumvallate papillae, adult; Standring S (ed), Gray's Anatomy 42e
fungiform_papillae: fungiform papillae on the human tongue
foliate_folds: foliate folds on each posterolateral tongue margin
taste_buds_total: total taste buds, adult human tongue
tongue_volume_mL: adult tongue volume (MRI volumetry, oral + pharyngeal portion)

bone.vault_join_rule: first axial level at which the upward-grown retained area jumps >=4x and the retained posterior extent jumps >=30 mm; this is the temporomandibular/zygomatic arch level at which the cranial vault joins
bone.occlusal_rule: local minimum of the anterior (y > 173.5 mm RAS, the incisor region) cross-sectional area of the frame, searched over its middle 60%
bone.bicondylar_definition: separation of the two condylar cluster CENTROIDS; the maximum lateral extent of the mandible is reported separately below and is the larger of the two numbers by construction
bone.mandible_vertical_extent_no_reference: reported WITHOUT a pass/fail judgement: there is no standard published reference for a posture-dependent vertical extent. The posture-free craniometric measure (condylion-menton straight-line distance) is audited instead.
bone.mandible_vertical_extent_definition: vertical (scene +y) extent from menton to the condylar apex IN THE SCAN'S OWN AXIAL FRAME. No head-posture normalisation was applied, and this quantity depends on how the head was positioned in the gantry.
bone.arch_width_definition: chord across the OUTER alveolar rim of the measured arch polyline: an external alveolar breadth, not a tooth-to-tooth width
bone.arch_perimeter_no_reference: the rim perimeter inside the declared 42 mm window has no standard published reference and is reported without a pass/fail judgement
bone.bigonial_breadth_mm_reference_source: gonion-gonion breadth, adult; Farkas LG, Anthropometry of the Head and Face, 2nd ed. 1994 (male mean 97.1 +/- 5.8 mm, female 91.0 +/- 5.9 mm)
bone.condylion_menton_mm_reference_source: condylion-menton straight-line distance (mandibular length), adult; Farkas 1994 / craniometric series
bone.maxillary_arch_width_molar_mm_reference_: maxillo-alveolar (EXTERNAL alveolar, ekm-ekm) breadth, adult craniometry. This is a BONE measure and is deliberately NOT the intermolar crown width (40-56 mm), which is a tooth-to-tooth measure and is used in this build only to size the teeth.
bone.mandibular_arch_width_molar_mm_reference: mandibular external alveolar breadth at the molars, adult craniometry
bone.maxillary_arch_width_canine_mm_reference: external alveolar breadth at the canine level, adult craniometry
bone.mandibular_arch_width_canine_mm_referenc: external alveolar breadth at the canine level, adult craniometry

oropharyngeal_level.note: the hard palate of an adult in neutral head position lies at roughly the level of the C1 anterior arch; this difference is reported as measured, not corrected
